title: BAL@ATL-card
universal_lens: Ballistics Window integrates environmental, biophysical, and cognitive domains into a unified causal lattice. Air density and wind modulate projectile dynamics; injury status alters strategic depth; news flow influences market attention. Mathematical structure: \( \mathcal{W} = f(\rho, \vec{v}, \mathcal{I}, \mathcal{N}) \), where \( \mathcal{W} \) is the windowed tactical space.
gsi_mapping: Bayesian update on \( \mathcal{W} \) via \( P(\mathcal{W}|\mathcal{D}) \propto P(\mathcal{D}|\mathcal{W})P(\mathcal{W}) \), incorporating weather, injury, and news data streams. Conformal prediction bounds \( \mathcal{W} \)’s uncertainty. GSI maps \( \mathcal{W} \) to \( \mathbb{R}^{n} \) using \( \mathcal{F}_{\text{ballistics}} \times \mathcal{F}_{\text{injury}} \times \mathcal{F}_{\text{news}} \).
gse_mapping: Situational reasoning models \( \mathcal{W} \) as a dynamic state-space \( \mathcal{S}(t) \) evolving under \( \mathcal{T}_{\text{weather}}, \mathcal{T}_{\text{injury}}, \mathcal{T}_{\text{market}} \). State transitions encode \( \Delta \mathcal{W} \) via \( \dot{\mathcal{S}} = \mathcal{T}(\mathcal{W}) \). GSE resolves \( \mathcal{S}(t) \to \mathcal{S}(t+\Delta t) \) through \( \mathcal{M}_{\text{edge}} \) and \( \mathcal{M}_{\text{pressure}} \).

Each component contributes a scalar field to \( \mathcal{W} \). The \( \mathcal{W} \) space is defined as a product of these fields: \( \mathcal{W} = \mathcal{F}_{\text{ballistics}} \times \mathcal{F}_{\text{injury}} \times \mathcal{F}_{\text{news}} \). The \( \mathcal{F}_{\text{ballistics}} \) is governed by \( \Delta d = k_{\text{ball}} \cdot (\rho - \rho_{\text{std}}) \cdot v_{\text{wind}} \), which modifies trajectory outcomes. \( \mathcal{F}_{\text{injury}} \) introduces \( \Delta \mathcal{S}_{\text{snap}} \), shifting strategic allocations. \( \mathcal{F}_{\text{news}} \) induces \( \Delta \mathcal{O} \), causing market misalignment. Failure modes include \( \mathcal{W} \) collapse under \( \rho \to 0 \) or \( \mathcal{I} \to \emptyset \).
